verdict_text:
YES

The adapter key prefix (`base_model.model.model.layers.<i>.<module>`) maps correctly onto the base name `model.layers.<i>.<module>.weight`; `scale` is read as `lora_alpha / r = 2` and `fan_in_fan_out = false` correctly leaves `B @ A` (`[out, in]`) untransposed; the accumulation is done in float32 and cast back to the base dtype (float32), so name, shape and dtype are preserved. No adapter or intermediate tensor is inserted into the state dict, all other tensors are passed through untouched, and all four required checks (32 merges, no `lora_` key, `[2048, 2048]` shape, 114 tensors) are asserted before writing. The sharded write with the 512 MiB budget is delegated to `save_sharded_safetensors`, which is invoked with the correct limit and output directory.
